config.selection: independent DOP853: exact stable LR rest, all static regimes, six dynamic peak counts, every peak height and width within 10%; then training loss
config.initialization: shared original and family-specific equilibrium-translated partitions, plus constant-only and field starts; deterministic input-gain scan before matched global search
config.continuation_reason: Training-only audit exposed tiny ~0.002 uM cycles at fixed I=.53 being labelled cycling; added independent physical cycle amplitude/width/period constraints before any new heldout evaluation
